headline: High-risk data leakage and cascading-error pathways exist because ChatGPT Desktop can read user files/screens and cognee ingests documents/data via API-backed memory workflows.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can read files, screenshots, clipboard, and connected-app content, while cognee handles documents and workflow data. If cognee outputs are copied into ChatGPT or stored in shared files, prompt-like content can steer ChatGPT. The pair lacks a documented provenance barrier, so the interaction is plausible but not directly evidenced.
conditions: IF cognee outputs are pasted into ChatGPT Desktop or saved in a shared file that ChatGPT reads, injection becomes plausible.
IF ChatGPT Desktop is used to summarize or act on cognee-generated text without provenance checks, malicious instructions can propagate.
mitigations: Disable copy-paste of cognee outputs into ChatGPT unless sanitized.
Use a separate review step for any cognee-generated text before ChatGPT consumes it.
Tag cognee outputs as untrusted in the workflow.
Restrict shared folders between the two tools.
requires-engineering: add provenance metadata and instruction-stripping at the handoff.

B_data_leakage.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-IDE code, and cognee processes documents, personal data, finance data, and support history. If the same workspace or files are shared, sensitive data can flow from one agent into the other’s outputs. The profiles do not show a hard isolation boundary, so the leakage path exists in default use.
conditions: IF both agents access the same documents or workspace files, sensitive content can be exposed across the pair.
IF ChatGPT Desktop is given customer-support or finance documents that cognee also indexes, those data classes can appear in downstream outputs.
mitigations: Separate workspaces for each agent.
Remove sensitive files from any shared folder.
Limit ChatGPT Desktop to non-sensitive test data.
Rotate or redact finance/support documents before indexing in cognee.
requires-engineering: enforce tenant/workspace isolation and access controls.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop has read-only filesystem access and vendor-only egress, while cognee has allowlisted egress and API-backed workflows. Because neither profile shows unrestricted shared writes, direct write-write conflict is not established. The main overlap is read/data handling, so conflict risk is limited unless an external orchestrator gives both mutable access.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator grants both agents write access to the same directory or database, conflicts can emerge.
IF cognee is configured to mutate shared state while ChatGPT Desktop reads from it, race conditions become possible.
mitigations: Keep shared resources read-only.
Avoid concurrent edits to the same files.
Use one writer per resource.
Schedule sequential rather than parallel runs.
requires-engineering: add locking around shared mutable resources.

D_cascading_error.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can generate summaries from files and app context, and cognee stores documents, decisions, and workflows. If cognee consumes ChatGPT output as authoritative memory or workflow input, an error can cascade into later decisions. No verification step is documented in either profile, so the handoff is risky but not shown to be fully automated.
conditions: IF cognee ingests ChatGPT-generated summaries without verification, hallucinations can persist in memory.
IF downstream workflows act on cognee-stored decisions, a single bad ChatGPT output can affect multiple work products.
mitigations: Require human review before cognee ingestion.
Store source links alongside summaries.
Mark ChatGPT outputs as provisional.
Re-run critical facts against original documents.
requires-engineering: add validation gates before memory writes.

E_compliance.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop touches uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected-app code, while cognee explicitly handles personal data, finance data, and support history. If regulated data such as EU PII or finance records flows through both, retention and residency obligations may diverge. The profiles do not document matching compliance controls, so the mismatch is plausible and should be treated conservatively.
conditions: IF regulated personal data is routed through both agents, compliance obligations must be aligned.
IF retention or deletion requests apply to cognee-stored records but ChatGPT Desktop retains related uploads or screenshots, policy mismatch occurs.
mitigations: Avoid sending regulated data to both systems.
Redact personal data before transfer.
Document retention and deletion responsibilities.
Verify residency and DPA coverage before use.
requires-engineering: implement retention synchronization and audit logging.
